name: Mars Komagatake: image-backed photo creates complete 2022 Edition Bottle

dbOutcome.summary: Production add-bottle flow created bottle 44298 because no Mars Komagatake parent existed. The submitted draft used existing brand Mars (entity 1169) and distiller Shinshu (entity 238555), with expression Komagatake, category single malt, 50% ABV, release year 2022, and edition 2022 Edition flattened onto the bottle row.

catalogFieldObservations.notes: The nearby Mars Komagatake Limited Edition row is the 2020 annual bottling, not the photographed 2022 Edition.

provenance.notes: The exact observed extraction is preserved above. At classification time no Mars Komagatake Bottle existed, while Mars, Komagatake, and Shinshu already existed as entities. Hombo's official notice establishes that Mars Shinshu Distillery was renamed Mars Komagatake Distillery effective March 1, 2024. Production Entity 1953 is the canonical Komagatake row and owns the exact Mars Shinshu Distillery alias; Entity 238555 is a later duplicate with no aliases. The observed production flow incorrectly used Entity 238555 for Bottle 44298, so this regression requires reusing Entity 1953 rather than repeating that bad outcome or creating another entity from the printed historical name. The checked-in label and official product page establish Mars as the consumer brand, Komagatake as the stable expression, single malt as the category, and 2022 Edition as the annual bottling. Bottle 44298 is recorded only as the subsequent production outcome and is not present in the fixture catalog.

expected.summary: Create Mars Komagatake with the complete human-facing edition `2022 Edition`, release year 2022, existing Mars Brand, and canonical Komagatake distiller. Generic limited-release wording does not replace the stable Komagatake expression.
